y-m-63-05.topic: Soosaarka shaqooyinka tibaax-badan: hubinta khaladaadka xalka adigoo isticmaalaya xeerka wax-ku-dhufashada
y-m-63-05.goal: Xal ka helaya soosaarka shaqo wax-ku-dhufasho ah, hel khadka khaladka leh, sharax in qiime isku mid ah hal dhibic uusan dammaanad qaadin in xalku sax yahay, oo si sax ah dib u qor.
y-m-63-05.material:
Hajun wuxuu helay soosaarka f′(x) ee f(x)=(x²+1)(x³−x) sidan. (x² waxaa loo akhriyaa 'x labajibbaaran' x³ na waa 'x saddexjibbaaran'.)
Khadadku waa khadka 1aad, 2aad, 3aad, iyo 4aad ee kor ka bilaabmaya.

y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.1: Erayo ku qor xeerka khad kasta, ku dabaq xeerkaas wax-ku-dhufasho aad u fudud sida x·x, ballaari oo si toos ah u soosaar, oo isbarbar dhig natiijada.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqdaan g(x)=x²+1 iyo h(x)=x³−x. Markaas f(x)=g(x)h(x).
y-m-63-05.s.s1.explain: Khadka 3aad waa khalad. Soosaarka wax-ku-dhufashada laba shaqo maaha g′(x)h′(x) laakiin waa g′(x)h(x)+g(x)h′(x). Tusaalaha fudud x·x, wax-ku-dhufashada soosaarradu waa 1·1=1, laakiin soosaarka x² waa 2x. Khadadka 1 iyo 2 waa sax, khadka 4aad na wuxuu keliya xisaabiyaa natiijada khadka 3aad sidiisa.

y-m-63-07.title: Xariiq taabanaysa oo maraysa barta P ma hal baa jirta?
y-m-63-07.topic: Isla'egta xariiq taabanaysa: xariiqyada taabanaya ee laga sawiro bar curvaha dibadda ah
y-m-63-07.goal: Hannaanka helidda xariiqyada taabanaya ee laga sawiro bar aan ku jirin curvaha, kala saar barta taabashada iyo barta xariiqdu maraan, oo si toos ah u xaqiiji in ay jiri karaan dhowr xariiq oo taabanaya oo suurtagal ah.
y-m-63-07.material:
Waxaa jira curve y=x² iyo bar P(1, −3). (Akhri 'y waa x labajibbaar'.) Marka x=1, qiimaha y ee curvaha waa 1, sidaas darteed barta P ma aha bar curvaha ku taal. Nara ayaa sidan u xalisay. 
 "Haddii f(x)=x², markaas f′(x)=2x iyo f′(1)=2. Sidaas darteed xariiqda taabanaysa maraysa barta P(1, −3) leh jaleeco 2 waa y−(−3)=2(x−1), taasi waa, y=2x−5." 
 Xariiq taabanaysa waa xariiq marta bar curvaha ku taal (barta taabashada) oo leh derivative-ka barta taas sida jaleecadiisa.

y-m-63-07.thinking.2: Ka sababee tirada xariiqyada taabanaya iyadoo loo eegayo booska barta
y-m-63-07.prereq.1: Macnaha joomatari ee derivative-ka (jaleecada xariiqda taabanaysa) iyo derivative-ka shaqada labajibbaarka sida y=x²
y-m-63-07.s.s1.hint.0: Isla'egyo ku hubi haddii xariiqda Nara heshay iyo curvaha runtii ay ku kulmaan hal bar.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig barta curvaha jaleecada 2 ay tahay qiimaha, iyo isku-duubyada barta P.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.a: Waxaa jiray khalad xisaabeed marka la helayo f′(x)=2x, geliinta x=1 na sidoo kale waxay ahayd khalad.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.a: Xisaabta derivative-ka waa sax. Xukunkani ma baarin jaleecada barta kee ayuu qiimaha 2 yahay.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.b: Jaleecada 2 waa qiimaha barta (1, 1) ee curvaha, laakiin P ma aha barta taabashada.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa xukun kala saaray jaleecada barta taabashada iyo barta xariiqdu maraan.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.c: Qorista isla'egta xariiq sida y−y₁=m(x−x₁) looma isticmaali karo xariiqyada taabanaya.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.c: Tani waa fikir u arkay qaabka isla'egta xariiqda sida dhibaato. Qaabka isla'egtu waa sax, dhibaatadu na waa macnaha qiimayaasha la geliyey.

y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa fikir u arkay calaamadda isku-duubyada sida go'aaminaysa haddii xariiq taabanaysa jirto.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.explain: f′(1)=2 waa jaleecada barta (1, 1) ee curvaha. Barta P ma ku taal curvaha, sidaas darteed ma aha barta taabashada. Dhab ahaan, xallinta y=2x−5 iyo y=x² wada waxay siinaysaa x²−2x+5=0, kaas oo aan lahayn xidid dhab ah, sidaas darteed xariiqdan xitaa ma taabato curvaha.
